about.title: About
about.description: Learn about BrowserTools — a collection of free, privacy-first online tools that run entirely in your browser.
about.heading: About BrowserTools
about.p1: BrowserTools is a collection of free online tools designed to be fast, private, and accessible to everyone. Unlike traditional online tools that upload your files to a server for processing, every tool on this site runs entirely in your web browser.
about.missionP: We believe utility tools should be simple, fast, and respectful of your privacy. That is why we build tools that work without requiring accounts, without uploading your data, and without adding unnecessary complexity.
about.howItWorksP: All processing happens locally using standard browser APIs such as Canvas, Web Crypto, and the File API. When you upload a file to one of our tools, it never leaves your device. This means:
about.howItWorksLi1: Your data stays private — no server uploads
about.howItWorksLi2: Processing is instant — no network latency
about.howItWorksLi3: Tools work offline once the page is loaded
about.howItWorksLi4: No file size limits imposed by server constraints
about.technologyP: This site is built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It is deployed on Vercel and optimized for performance and accessibility. The architecture is designed to be easily extensible — new tools can be added without modifying dozens of files.
about.contactP: Have a suggestion for a new tool or found a bug? We would love to hear from you. Visit our contact page to get in touch.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with the BrowserTools team. Suggest new tools, report bugs, or send feedback.
contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.p1: Have a suggestion for a new tool, found a bug, or want to share feedback? We would love to hear from you.
contact.suggestToolP: We are actively expanding our tool collection. If there is a tool you need that we do not yet offer, let us know. We prioritize tools that can run entirely client-side and do not require paid APIs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for BrowserTools. We do not collect, store, or transmit your data. All tools run entirely in your browser.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Your privacy is fundamental to how BrowserTools operates. This policy explains what data we do and do not collect.
privacy.toolDataP: All tools on BrowserTools process data entirely within your browser. When you use any tool — whether compressing an image, converting text, or generating a password — the data you provide is never sent to our servers. We do not have access to your files, inputs, or outputs.
privacy.analyticsP: We may use privacy-respecting analytics to understand which tools are most used and how visitors find the site. We do not use cross-site tracking cookies. Any analytics we use are configured to not collect personally identifiable information.
privacy.cookiesP: BrowserTools does not set any cookies for tool functionality. If we add analytics in the future, we will update this policy and provide appropriate disclosure.
privacy.thirdPartyP: Our site is hosted on Vercel. When you visit BrowserTools, Vercel may process basic request data (IP address, request headers) to serve the website. This is standard for any website and is governed by Vercel's Privacy Policy.
privacy.advertisingP: If we introduce advertising in the future, we will update this policy to disclose what advertising partners we work with and what data they may collect. We are committed to using only privacy-respecting ad networks.
privacy.changesP: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.contactP: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please visit our contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service

terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.p1: By using BrowserTools, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use the site.
terms.freeUseP: BrowserTools provides all tools free of charge. You may use the tools for personal or commercial purposes without restriction.
terms.noWarrantyP: All tools are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee that the tools will be error-free, uninterrupted, or produce accurate results. You are responsible for verifying the output of any tool before relying on it.
terms.liabilityP: BrowserTools shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of or inability to use the tools provided on this site.
terms.ipP: The site design, code, and branding are the property of BrowserTools. The tools themselves process your data and produce output that belongs to you.
terms.acceptableUseP: You agree not to use BrowserTools for any unlawful purpose or in any way that could damage, disable, or impair the site.
terms.changesTermsP: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.contactP: If you have questions about these Terms, please visit our contact page.

image-compressor.name: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images in your browser. Adjust quality and preview results instantly — no uploads.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Resize images to any dimensions in your browser. Lock aspect ratio, use presets, and export as PNG, JPG, or WebP — no uploads.

jpg-to-webp.name: JPG to WebP
jpg-to-webp.description: Convert JPG images to WebP format in your browser. Adjust quality and compare file sizes — no uploads, no sign-up.

png-to-webp.name: PNG to WebP
png-to-webp.description: Convert PNG images to WebP format in your browser. Reduce file size while controlling quality — no uploads required.

jpg-to-png.name: JPG to PNG
jpg-to-png.description: Convert JPG images to PNG format in your browser. Get lossless output with transparency support — no uploads.

webp-to-jpg.name: WebP to JPG
webp-to-jpg.description: Convert WebP images to JPG format in your browser. Adjust quality and download instantly — no uploads, no sign-up.

png-to-jpg.name: PNG to JPG
png-to-jpg.description: Convert PNG images to JPG format in your browser. Adjust quality, set background color for transparency, and download instantly — no uploads.

webp-to-png.name: WebP to PNG
webp-to-png.description: Convert WebP images to PNG format in your browser. Get lossless output with transparency support — no uploads, no sign-up.

image-cropper.name: Image Cropper
image-cropper.description: Crop images in your browser with aspect ratio presets. Drag to adjust the crop area, choose output format, and download — no uploads.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a single PDF in your browser. Reorder pages, choose A4 or Letter size, and download — no uploads.

pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF to JPG
pdf-to-jpg.description: Convert PDF pages to JPG images in your browser. Select pages, adjust quality and resolution, and download individually or as a ZIP — no uploads.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one in your browser. Drag, drop, reorder, and merge — no uploads, no sign-up, completely free.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.description: Split or extract PDF pages in your browser. Extract specific page ranges or split every page into separate PDFs — no uploads required.

word-counter.name: Word Counter
word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time in real time. Free, instant, and entirely in your browser.

character-counter.name: Character Counter
character-counter.description: Count characters with and without spaces, words, and lines in real time. Free, instant, and entirely in your browser.

case-converter.name: Case Converter
case-converter.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, or toggle case instantly in your browser.

remove-duplicate-lines.name: Remove Duplicate Lines
remove-duplicate-lines.description: Remove duplicate lines from any text in your browser. Optional case sensitivity and whitespace trimming. See how many duplicates were removed.

text-sorter.name: Text Sorter
text-sorter.description: Sort lines of text alphabetically or numerically, ascending or descending. Optional case sensitivity, trimming, and empty line removal — all in your browser.

qr-code-generator.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code-generator.description: Generate QR codes from any text or URL in your browser. Customize size and error correction, then download as PNG — no uploads, no sign-up.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate secure passwords using the Web Crypto API. Configure length, character types, and exclude ambiguous characters — all in your browser.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.description: Generate UUID v4 identifiers in your browser using crypto.randomUUID(). Generate up to 50 UUIDs at once — no uploads, no sign-up.

random-number-generator.name: Random Number Generator
random-number-generator.description: Generate random numbers within a range using cryptographically secure randomness. Choose integer or decimal, generate up to 100 at once — all in your browser.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Calculate percentages in your browser — X% of Y, percentage increase/decrease, and percentage difference. Free, instant, no uploads.

discount-calculator.name: Discount Calculator
discount-calculator.description: Calculate discounts and final prices in your browser. Enter original price and discount percentage to see savings instantly — free, no sign-up.

age-calculator.name: Age Calculator
age-calculator.description: Calculate your exact age in years, months, and days from your date of birth. See total days, weeks, months, and next birthday — all in your browser.

date-calculator.name: Date Calculator
date-calculator.description: Add or subtract days from a date, or calculate the difference between two dates in days, weeks, months, and years — all in your browser.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) in metric or imperial units. See your BMI category instantly — free, no sign-up, all in your browser.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.description: Format, minify, and validate JSON in your browser. Choose 2 or 4 space indentation, see error messages, and copy results — no uploads.

base64-encoder.name: Base64 Encoder
base64-encoder.description: Encode text to Base64 in your browser. Supports UTF-8 text including emoji and special characters — no uploads, no sign-up.

base64-decoder.name: Base64 Decoder
base64-decoder.description: Decode Base64 to text in your browser. Supports UTF-8 text including emoji and special characters — no uploads, no sign-up.

unit-converter.name: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, and time in your browser. Free, instant, no sign-up.

lorem-ipsum-generator.name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
lorem-ipsum-generator.description: Generate Lorem Ipsum placeholder text in your browser. Choose paragraphs, sentences, or words — copy or download instantly, no sign-up.

url-encoder-decoder.name: URL Encoder/Decoder
url-encoder-decoder.description: Encode and decode URL parameters in your browser. Handle spaces, special characters, and percent-encoding — no uploads, no sign-up.
